Name: Elian - Custom NPC for SVE
Author: Silverinnia
Description:
[center][b][size=3]~ Installation ~
[/size][/b]1. Install all mods listed under requirements
2. Download and unzip ElianNPC
3. Place folder in your "\Stardew Valley\Mods" folder
4. Run game with SMAPI[/center]

I'm happy to bring you my first mod ever, Elian - a new marriage candidate designed for Stardew Valley Expanded, a mod created by FlashShifter. Elian is a demon who no longer trusts people and would prefer to live in solitude spending his days reading books about flowers and travel. Or so he says. It's up to you to help him open up his heart and realize the world isn't as black and white as he always thought.

You must have [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url] and all its dependencies installed for Elian to work.

Elian's home is in the Crimson Badlands, an area added by SVE. It is a cave in the eastern wall a little ways south of the badlands entrance. You'll see his introduction event the first time you enter his cave, and he will begin appearing as normal the following day. Schedules and dialogue vary based on events seen. He will begin attending festivals and you can invite him to movies after seeing his 6 heart event. He starts as non-dateable but becomes dateable after seeing both parts of his 8 heart event.

[b]Birthday[/b]: Summer 5

﻿[spoiler]Love: All flowers, including daffodil and dandelion, universal loves

Neutral: Universal neutrals

Hate: Cave carrot, miner's treat, roots platter, stir fry, survival burger, universal hates
[/spoiler]

﻿﻿[spoiler][b]Concessions:[/b]

Love: Cotton candy, chocolate popcorn, black licorice, star cookie

Like: Sour slimes, nachos, popcorn, fries, jawbreaker, rock candy

Dislike: Jasmine tea, ice cream sandwich, hummus snack pack, kale smoothie, panzanella salad


[b]Movies:[/b]

Love: The Brave Little Sapling, Journey of the Prairie King, Natural Wonders

Like: Wumbus, The Zuzu City Express

Dislike: Mysterium, The Miracle at Coldstar Ranch, It Howls in the Rain
[/spoiler]

[b][size=3]~ Events ~[/size][/b]
﻿﻿[spoiler][b]Introduction:[/b] Enter his cave at any time

[b]2 Heart:[/b] Have seen introduction, enter his cave between 6am to 10pm

[b]4 Heart:[/b]
Part 1: Have seen 2 heart, enter his cave between 6am to 10pm
Part 2: Have seen part 1, enter his cave at any time with poppy seeds in inventory
Part 3: 1 week after seeing part 2, enter his cave between 6am to 10pm

[b]6 Heart:[/b] Have seen 4 heart part 3, not a festival day, not winter, sunny, enter his cave between 8am to 2pm

[b]8 Heart:[/b]
Part 1: Have seen 6 heart, not a festival day, sunny, Thursday or Saturday, leave your house before 11am
Part 2: Have seen part 1, not a festival day, sunny, Thursday or Saturday, go to the beach between 11am to 5pm

[b]10 Heart:[/b]
Part 1: Dating, sunny, leave your house before 11am
Part 2: Have seen part 1, sunny, go to the bus stop between 12pm to 5pm
[/spoiler]

[b][size=3]~ Planned Updates ~[/size][/b]
- Add a marriage event (will likely be after SVE 2.0 is out)
- Add island visits
- More dialogue - season specific, day before festival, and interaction with others in town

[b][size=3]~ Multiplayer Compatibility ~[/size][/b]
Schedule updates happen once any player has seen the relevant event so there might be small inconsistencies with dialogue such as saying he'd like to see somewhere he's already been or watering a spot where there is no plant. Note for his 4 heart event, you should enter his cave with the requested item in your inventory rather than directly giving it to him even if he is married to another player and no longer lives there.

[b][size=3]~ Compatibility ~[/size][/b]
[url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286]Ridgeside Village[/url] - Elian will attend RSV festivals if installed (will still need to have seen his 6 heart event).
